items.note: The prompt doesn't say the product is a B2B note-taking app.
The prompt doesn't say the readers are the engineering and design leads, or that the PRD is for a kickoff.
The prompt doesn't list the v1 scope: creating a workspace, inviting members by email, and shared notes.
The prompt doesn't limit v1 roles to admin and member.
The prompt doesn't exclude billing changes, SSO, or guest access from v1.
The prompt doesn't give the success metric: 20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days.
The prompt doesn't set a length limit of about 2 pages.
The prompt doesn't say to leave migration of existing shared notes as an open question.
